study.title: Cancer mortality risk from short-term PM2.5 exposure and temporal variations in Brazil

outcomes.name: Sistema de Informacoes sobre Mortalidade (SIM)
outcomes.scope: 2019 deaths of residents of Sao Paulo state; the analysis filters residential municipality 355030 (Sao Paulo).

boundary.provider: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatistica

weather.scope: No-auth daily municipality-centroid weather substitute. The published study used population-weighted ERA5 grid cells, not this API.

exposure.estimand: Unweighted mean of daily monitor means within the supplied municipality polygon. This is a source substitution for the published population-weighted 0.25-degree all-source PM2.5 surface.

historical_recovery.scope: Official 2019 PM2.5 daily values for AERIS-selected station 31, Cid.Universitaria-USP-Ipen. Used only after the recorded AERIS/OpenAQ boundary run returned NO_OBSERVATIONS.
